SYNTHETIC EXPLANATORY EXAMPLE — not historical data or a strategy result
IFVG confirmed at bar 21 close → submit → earliest fill at bar 22 open.
Later touch at 114 inside [112,116] on bar 23 → submit after close → fill bar 24.
The interior touch is one synthetic example. The retest mode accepts any touch in the zone within its expiry.
The early exploratory variant is unconfirmed and is not depicted or labeled as an IFVG confirmation.
